title: Elisabet was amazing! She...
text:
Elisabet was amazing! She made the Park Güell and Gaudí Houses tour truly memorable. Her knowledge was impressive, and she explained everything in great detail, bringing Gaudí’s architecture and history to life. She was punctual, communicated clearly before and during the tour, and was both professional and friendly throughout the experience.

author: Diana_M

title: A perfect day of Gaudi
text: Lovely tour guide, very knowledgeable, great energy, and moved at a pace that was perfect for us. This was very enjoyable, and I'd recommend her to anyone.
author: Dinah_S
